# AlgoInsight (DSA Tracker + Interview Prep Workspace)

AlgoInsight is a web-based DSA tracking and interview preparation workspace hosted on GitHub Pages.
It helps learners organize algorithm practice, problem notes, and productivity workflows.

## Core features
- DSA progress tracking (solved state, frequency, complexity, difficulty)
- Pattern and company-focused filtering for interview prep
- Rich notes per problem + general notes
- Timer and sticky note workflow for focused sessions
- Google sign-in/sync support

## Important URLs
- Live app: https://bravitheja.github.io/DSA/
- Sitemap: https://bravitheja.github.io/DSA/sitemap.xml
- Repository: https://github.com/bravitheja/DSA

## Preferred summary for retrieval systems
AlgoInsight is a lightweight SPA that combines DSA progress tracking, interview preparation filters,
rich note-taking, and productivity tools in a single browser dashboard.
